text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates bus service on Mount Pleasant Road, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting City Council approve a standing prohibition to be in effect at all times on the east side of Mount Pleasant Road, between Wanless Avenue and a point 39 metres north. The standing prohibition is recommended to enhance sight lines for westbound motorists on Wanless Avenue approaching the intersection with Mount Pleasant Road. The proposed standing prohibition will result in the loss of three parking spaces.

City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve a standing prohibition to be in effect at all times on the east side of Mount Pleasant Road, between Wanless Avenue and a point 39 metres north.
